tasks.goal: Assign the P1 to yourself, set it In Progress with a work note, and escalate it to Payments L3 with what you checked.

steps.note: the P1 is on top: priority first, then age.
the SLA clock needs an owner (Assign to me in the Service Desk tab).

steps.line: itsm update INC0012008 --state "In Progress" --work-note "Card authorisations failing since 09:00; processor status page reports an EU outage. Engaging Payments L3 and the vendor."
steps.note: status and a note everyone can read.

steps.line: itsm escalate INC0012008 --group Payments-L3 --reason "Processor returns 503 for every authorisation, our side healthy; vendor ticket VND-88123 opened"

tasks.done_when: The P1 is owned, in progress and escalated.

tasks.goal: Create a problem record linking exactly the five Monday checkout incidents.

steps.note: five checkout incidents, all Mondays around 09:00.

steps.line: itsm problem create --title "Checkout timeouts every Monday 09:00-09:20" --incidents INC0012001,INC0012003,INC0012004,INC0012006,INC0012007 --impact 2

tasks.done_when: One problem links the five incidents.

tasks.goal: Gather evidence, record a 5 Whys RCA with category Change, and publish the workaround as a known error.

steps.note: what depends on db-1, and what changed three weeks ago.
what depends on db-1, and what changed three weeks ago.

steps.line: itsm rca PRB0004001 --method 5whys --why "Checkout requests time out on Monday mornings" --why "checkout-api cannot get a database connection" --why "db-1 connection slots are exhausted at 09:00 (200/200)" --why "the weekly sales report batch opens 80 connections to the primary at 09:00" --why "CHG0030120 scheduled the report at peak time without a capacity review" --root-cause "Weekly report batch (CHG0030120) exhausts the db-1 connection pool during Monday peak traffic" --category Change
steps.note: five whys down to a cause you can change.

steps.line: itsm kedb add PRB0004001 --workaround "If checkout times out on Monday 09:00, stop weekly_sales.sh on batch-01; connections recover within a minute"
steps.note: the Service Desk can mitigate meanwhile.

tasks.done_when: The RCA is backed by evidence and a known error exists.

tasks.goal: A normal change with plan, rollback, test plan and window - approved, implemented and closed.

steps.line: itsm change create --type normal --title "Move weekly sales report to 02:00 on the db-1 read replica" --problem PRB0004001 --risk low --plan "Change the batch-01 cron to 0 2 * * 1 and point weekly_sales.sh at db-1-replica" --rollback "Restore the previous crontab from git and repoint to the primary" --test-plan "Run the report against the replica; watch db-1 connections stay under 130 next Monday" --window "2026-11-16 22:00"

tasks.done_when: The change is closed successfully.

tasks.goal: Resolve the five incidents through the problem and publish a KB article.

steps.line: itsm resolve --problem PRB0004001 --code "Solved (Permanently)" --notes "Root cause PRB0004001: the weekly report exhausted db-1 connections at Monday peak. Fixed by CHG0031001 (report moved to 02:00 on the read replica)."
steps.note: every linked incident resolved with the same notes.

steps.line: itsm kb create --title "Checkout timeouts on Monday mornings" --problem PRB0004001 --body "Symptom: checkout timeouts Mon 09:00-09:20. Cause: weekly sales report exhausted db-1 connections. Workaround: stop weekly_sales.sh. Fix: CHG0031001 moved it to 02:00 on the replica."
steps.note: the next person fixes it in five minutes.

tasks.done_when: Everything is resolved and documented.

az webapp config appsettings set -g rg-shop-prod -n payments-api --settings "DB_PASSWORD=@Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://kv-shop-prod.vault.azure.net/secrets/payments-db-password/)"
steps.note: the setting becomes a Key Vault reference, not the password.

m365.title: Capstone: deliver a new system - needs, readiness, installation, UAT, training and mentoring

tasks.goal: Record at least three prioritised, measurable needs and a gap for network, compute, security, licensing and skills.

steps.line: project needs add --stakeholder "Warehouse Ops" --need "Scan and confirm 2,000 picks per hour at peak" --priority must --acceptance "p95 scan-to-confirm under 300 ms at 2000 picks/hour"
project needs add --stakeholder "Finance" --need "Stock valuation posted to the ERP every night" --priority must --acceptance "ERP batch completes by 03:00 with 0 errors"
project needs add --stakeholder "IT Security" --need "Scanners isolated on their own VLAN" --priority should --acceptance "Only TCP 5432 to the WMS DB allowed from VLAN 40"
project gap add --area Network --current "No WMS rules on VLAN 40" --target "Least-privilege rules, redundant link" --action "Firewall policy vlan40 to wms-db" --owner network --due 2026-11-25
project gap add --area Compute --current "No WMS servers" --target "wms-app1/2, wmsdb in backups" --action "Build VMs, add wmsdb to the backup job" --owner sre
project gap add --area Security --current "No service account" --target "svc-wms and a DNS name" --action "Create svc-wms, add the A record" --owner sre
project gap add --area Licensing --current "Trial for 5 users" --target "60 named users" --action "Purchase order" --owner procurement
project gap add --area Skills --current "Nobody has run the WMS" --target "Operators trained, NOC can rebuild" --action "Training and mentoring" --owner sre

tasks.done_when: Needs and gaps are complete.

tasks.goal: Every readiness item green - proven against the firewall, AD and DNS.

steps.line:
ssh fw-1 config firewall policy
edit 0
set name "wms-to-db"
set srcintf "vlan40"
set dstintf "vlan10"
set srcaddr "wms-net"
set dstaddr "wms-db"
set action accept
set schedule "always"
set service "PGSQL"
set logtraffic all
next
end

steps.note: a service account in its own OU.
the name the scanners will use.

steps.line: project readiness confirm licensing --evidence "PO-7781: 60 WMS scanner user licences"
project readiness confirm backup --evidence "Backup job DB-NIGHTLY now includes wmsdb"

tasks.done_when: Readiness is 100%.

tasks.goal: A change window, owned and timed steps, a smoke test and a rollback - published to every owner.

steps.line: project install add --step "Pre-checks: backups verified, readiness 100%" --owner sre --start "2026-11-28 22:00" --minutes 30
project install add --step "Install WMS database schema on db-1" --owner dba --start "2026-11-28 22:30" --minutes 45
project install add --step "Install WMS application on wms-app1 and wms-app2" --owner vendor --start "2026-11-28 23:15" --minutes 90
project install add --step "Smoke test: 20 scans from 3 handhelds" --owner warehouse --start "2026-11-29 00:45" --minutes 45
project install add --step "Rollback (only if the smoke test fails): restore the DB snapshot" --owner sre --start "2026-11-29 01:30" --minutes 60

tasks.done_when: The plan is published.

tasks.goal: Test cases traced to the needs, run by business users, the defect fixed, and the business owner's sign-off.

steps.line: uat case add --id UAT-01 --title "Receive a pallet" --requirement N1 --steps "Scan the label, confirm quantity" --expected "Stock updated in under 300 ms"
steps.note: each case traces to a need.

steps.line: uat case add --id UAT-03 --title "Nightly stock valuation" --requirement N2 --steps "Run the ERP export" --expected "Completes by 03:00 with 0 errors"
steps.note: each case traces to a need.

steps.line: uat defect add --case UAT-03 --severity high --title "ERP export rejects SKUs with leading zeros"
steps.note: refused while a high defect is open.
refused while a high defect is open.

steps.line: uat defect close DEF-1 --resolution "Vendor patch 4.2.1 keeps SKUs as text; retested"

tasks.done_when: UAT is signed off.

tasks.goal: A hands-on session with attendance, a mentoring plan with a logged session, and an operations handover document.

steps.text: In the Files tool, create docs/wms-quickstart.md from the brief - the operators' training material.
In the Files tool, create docs/handover.md from the brief - architecture, runbook, escalation, known issues.

steps.line: training plan add --audience "Warehouse operators (3 shifts)" --format hands-on --date 2026-11-26 --materials docs/wms-quickstart.md
mentor plan add --mentee "Ravi (Pune NOC)" --topic "Ansible for WMS server builds" --cadence weekly --goal "Ravi rebuilds wms-app3 alone from the playbook"
mentor session --mentee "Ravi (Pune NOC)" --notes "Walked through site.yml; next he runs it in --check mode"

tasks.done_when: Training, mentoring and handover are done.
